## What the tool shows

The active public interface associated with the completed UK Co-Benefits Atlas project, providing access to place-based estimates and documented methods.

Place-based estimates can be difficult to inspect or compare when the underlying spatial variation and documented methods are not available through an accessible interface.

How can users explore the place-based estimates and methods developed through the UK Co-Benefits Atlas?

## How it can be used

The tool allows users to inspect how represented benefits and costs vary across UK communities while retaining the limits of the underlying estimates.

## What users should not infer

Availability does not make the underlying estimates current, universal or transferable to another place.

## Data and methods

The active public interface exposes the completed Atlas outputs and documented methods for exploration; it does not itself establish new findings.

Public tool verified as available on 27 August 2026.
